event_section.hydrographic_context: Minor watercourse in the Arcevia event area

network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto include Arcevia nel nucleo pluviometrico dell'evento, ma non pubblica una sezione idrometrica sul torrente Acquaviva compatibile con questo ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report includes Arcevia within the event rainfall core but publishes no Acquaviva hydrometric section compatible with this bridge.

sources.title: Rapporto di evento: maltempo 15, 16 e 17 settembre 2022

curation_note.it: La stazione pluviometrica di Arcevia documenta la forzante meteorologica ma non è un idrometro. ARCUS non converte la pioggia in livello o portata del torrente Acquaviva.
curation_note.en: The Arcevia rain gauge documents the meteorological forcing but is not a stream gauge. ARCUS does not convert rainfall into stage or discharge for the Acquaviva stream.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official regional event report

caveats: Rainfall observations are not hydrometric observations.
No compatible Acquaviva gauge section is published in the reviewed report.
No stage, discharge or hydrograph is assigned to the bridge.
Basin processes do not by themselves prove the bridge-collapse mechanism.
